sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any one person is gone, the whole reach quietly resolves to nothing.
sketches.draft:
let you: Person? = nil
let answer = you?.heart?.room(for: me)

sketches.mechanism: The 'object' keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist, enforced by the compiler
sketches.resonance: Declaring something unique in the world, the language guarantees there will never be another.

sketches.mechanism: Unification failure — when two terms cannot unify, the query simply fails with no solution
sketches.resonance: Two people who cannot be made to match; the logic engine exhausts all possibilities and confirms there is no world in which they fit together.
sketches.draft:
fits(me, you) :- me = you.
?- fits(me, you).
